[SWS_CM_00742] Local access control on executing field getters
⌈
If a Process
executes a getter in a Field of a ServiceInterface, but there exists no Com-
FieldGrant that
• does not reference any remote subject in the role remoteSubject and
• references the requested RequiredApServiceInstance in the role servi-
ceInstance and the RequiredApServiceInstance is referenced by a Ser-
viceInstanceToPortPrototypeMapping in the role serviceInstance
and the ServiceInstanceToPortPrototypeMapping references the re-
questing Process in the role process,
• references the enclosing Field in the role serviceDeployment and
• that has a role attribute either set to getter or getterSetter
then Communication Management shall drop the request. In that case the field.Get
() method shall handle the error as a InsufficientPermissionsViolation.
⌋
